plan.title: SRC-ERX-019 Missing Auction Template Savings Check

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects for the test company.
Add the Technical Stage while retaining the Auction stage.
Apply a template to the Technical Stage so the missing template is isolated to Auction.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete required Technical Stage questionnaire content.
Assign the evaluator required for publishing a Technical Stage.
Return to Auction, the stage whose template is intentionally missing.
